meetings.agenda: Award recommendation for open tender RSAJ/TA/109/2026 — Kerja-kerja Menaik Taraf Loji Rawatan Air Sungai Bekok, Fasa 2, Batu Pahat.
meetings.minutes: The Board noted the evaluation report and the company estimate of RM4.42 million. The recommended tenderer was the lowest compliant offer at 5.4% below estimate, with a CIDB G7 registration current to March 2028. Award approved.

decisions.subject: Kerja-kerja Menaik Taraf Loji Rawatan Air Sungai Bekok, Fasa 2, Batu Pahat

votes.comment: Lowest compliant offer; technical evaluation passed at 78%.
Programme of works acceptable against the plant shutdown window.
Contractor's performance report for RSAJ/TA/071/2024 was graded Sederhana. Recommend closer supervision if awarded.

meetings.agenda: Appointment recommendation — open quotation RSAJ/KP/Q(JB)/031/26, Naik Taraf Paip Agihan Jalan Skudai Kiri, Johor Bahru.
meetings.minutes: Three quotations received, one rejected for an expired CIDB registration. The recommended contractor met the capital test at 3% of the company estimate with materials drawn from the Ranhill SAJ store. Recommended to the Chief Executive Officer for approval.

decisions.subject: Naik Taraf Paip Agihan Jalan Skudai Kiri, Johor Bahru

votes.comment: Lowest compliant quotation; financial test passed.
Price variance 4.1% below the company estimate — Kompetitif.
Technical capacity verified against CIDB grade G4.

meetings.agenda: Variation order VO/T/018/2026 — additional piling to the intake chamber, LRA Sungai Bekok, against contract RSAJ/KP/T/07/2025.

decisions.subject: VO/T/018/2026 — cerucuk tambahan pada ruang pengambilan, LRA Sungai Bekok

votes.comment: Ground conditions differ materially from the soil investigation report.
Cumulative variation remains under 2% of the contract sum.
Rates for the additional piling are not in the schedule; request a re-measure before recommending.
